fact: A depot is a Sahmline Parcel facility. A parcel scanned there is still in the carrier network.
Mizn & Dune matches the parcel to an order when its warehouse checks it in. The warehouse receipt appears as return_received.
Customers may see an app notification later than the carrier event that triggered it. The event timestamp belongs to the scan.
Sahmline Parcel may capture a photo, signature, or recipient code. Each evidence type identifies different parts of the handoff.
The support ledger stores the order, earlier action, completion status, and whether the action concerns the issue being reviewed.
The order lookup gives the current replacement stock for the same item. It does not represent the stock for similar products.
